01

“When the earth is shaken with a [severe] shaking”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 56:4).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
When the earth is shaken with a [severe] shaking [al-Waqia 4] meaning: "when it is made to quake."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا [الواقعة: 4] ، يَعْنِي: «إِذَا زُلْزِلَتْ»
Edition record 373524 · p. 640Link to report ↗
02

“and the mountains are crumbled [bussat] with crumbling”

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and the mountains are crumbled [bussat] with crumbling [al-Waqia 5] He says: "pulverized."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا [الواقعة: 5] يَقُولُ: «فُتَّتْ فَتًّا»
Edition record 373525 · p. 640Link to report ↗

Report from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, who said:
"The bass is the mixing, as barley meal is mixed."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:

Report from ʿAlī 04

ʿAlī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from al-Harith, from Ali ﷺ who said:
"The scattered dust: the dust kicked up by animals."
العربية

" الْهَبَاءُ الْمُنْبَثُّ: رَهَجُ الدَّوَابِّ "

04

“There will circulate among them young boys made eternal”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and al-Ḥasan (Q 56:17).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
There will circulate among them young boys made eternal [al-Waqia 17] He says: "they neither die nor grow old."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ [الواقعة: 17] يَقُولُ: «لَا يَمُوتُونَ وَلَا يَكْبُرُونَ»
Edition record 373530 · p. 641Link to report ↗
08
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 08

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, on His words:
young boys made eternal [al-Waqia 17] he said: "They had no good deeds for which to be rewarded and no evil deeds for which to be punished, so they were placed in this position."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَلَدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونٌ [الواقعة: 17] قَالَ: «لَمْ تَكُنْ حَسَنَاتٌ، فَيَجُزُونَ بِهَا، وَلَا سَيِّئَاتٌ فَيُعَاقَبُونَ عَلَيْهَا، فَوُضِعُوا بِهَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ»
Edition record 373531 · p. 641Link to report ↗

07

“and layered acacia [talh]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 56:29).

11
Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and layered acacia [talh] [al-Waqia 29]: "piled-up bananas; that is because they admired Wajj and its shade of its acacia and lote trees."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَطَلْحٍ مَنْضُودٍ [الواقعة: 29] «الْمَوْزُ الْمُتَرَاكِمُ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَعْجَبُونَ بِوَجٍّ، وَظِلَالِهِ مِنْ طَلْحِهِ وَسِدْرِهِ»
Edition record 373534 · p. 642Link to report ↗
08

“and extended shade”

An explanation transmitted from Shuayb ibn al-Habhab (Q 56:30).

12
Explanation from Shuayb ibn al-Habhab 12

Shuayb ibn al-Habhab

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Zayd and al-Mahdi ibn Maymun related to us, from Shuayb ibn al-Habhab, who said:
"I went out with Abu al-Aliya al-Riyahi, and when we were in the mountains, before sunrise, he said: 'I was told that Paradise is like this,'" and then recited and extended shade [al-Waqia 30].
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدِ، وَالْمَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ، قَالَ:
«خَرَجْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ الرِّيَاحِيُّ، فَلَمَّا كُنَّا بِالْجِبَالِ، وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ» ، قَالَ: «نُبِّئْتُ أَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هَكَذَا» ثُمَّ تَلَا وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ [الواقعة: 30]
Edition record 373535 · p. 642Link to report ↗
09

“Indeed, We have produced them [women of Paradise] in a [new]…”

Three explanations transmitted from Salama ibn Yazid and al-Ḥasan (Q 56:35).

13
Explanation from Salama ibn Yazid 13

Salama ibn Yazid

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Jabir al-Jufi, from Yazid ibn Murra, from Salama ibn Yazid, who said:
I heard the Prophet ﷺ say, concerning the words of God, Mighty and Majestic: Indeed, We have produced them [women of Paradise] in a [new] creation [al-Waqia 35] meaning: "the previously married and the virgins who were in the world."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ الْجُعْفِيِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل:
إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً [الواقعة: 35] ، يَعْنِي: «الثَّيِّبَ وَالْأَبْكَارَ اللَّاتِي كُنَّ فِي الدُّنْيَا»
Edition record 373536 · p. 642Link to report ↗
14
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 14

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "An old woman will not enter Paradise." He said: "An old woman wept." The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Tell her that she will not be an old woman that day; she will be young that day, for God, Mighty and Majestic, says: Indeed, We have produced them in a [new] creation [al-Waqia 35]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ:
«لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ الْعَجُوزُ» قَالَ: «فَبَكَتْ عَجُوزٌ» ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: " أَخْبِرُوهَا لَيْسَتْ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِعَجُوزٍ، وَأَنَّهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ شَابَّةٌ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ عز وجل يَقُولُ: إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً [الواقعة: 35] "
Edition record 373537 · p. 642Link to report ↗
15
Report from al-Ḥasan 15

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
"The urub are those who are passionately in love with their husbands, and the atrab are those of equal age." Mujahid said: "The beloved to their husbands; as for His word atraban, He says: equals."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
" الْعُرُبُ: الْمُعَشَّقَاتُ لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ، وَالْأَتْرَابُ: الْمُسْتَوِيَاتُ بِسِنٍّ وَاحِدٍ ". أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: " الْمُحَبَّبَاتُ إِلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ، وَأَمَّا قَوْلُهُ: أَتْرَابًا فَيَقُولُ: أَمْثَالًا "
Edition record 373538 · p. 643Link to report ↗

“a company of the former peoples”

Explanation from Mujāhid 16

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording

“a company of the former peoples and a company of the later peoples”

An explanation transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn (Q 56:40).

17
Explanation from Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn 17

Muḥammad ibn Sīrīn

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Abu Hilal al-Rasibi related to us, from Muhammad ibn Sirin:
a company of the former peoples and a company of the later peoples [al-Waqia 40] he said: "They used to say: all of them are from this community."

ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْآخَرِينَ [الواقعة: 40] قَالَ: " كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: كُلُّهُمْ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ "

“by the setting of the stars [mawaqi al-nujum]”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 56:75).

30
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 30

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Sharik related to us, from Hakim ibn Jubayr, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas:
by the setting of the stars [mawaqi al-nujum] [al-Waqia 75]: "the stars of the Qur'an. That is because the Qur'an was sent down to the nearest heaven all at once, then was sent in portions to the Prophet ﷺ in installments: in separate pieces, a verse, two verses, or more."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا شَرِيكُ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
بِمَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ [الواقعة: 75] : " نُجُومِ الْقُرْآنِ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا جَمِيعًا جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً، ثُمَّ نُجِّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نُجُومًا: فِرَقًا: قِطَعًا، الْآيَةَ، وَالْآيَتَانِ وَأَكْثَرَ "

Report from Mujāhid 38

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, he said:
"The ruh is goodness and hope, and the rayhan is provision."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الرَّوْحُ: خَيْرٌ وَرَجَاءٌ، وَالرَّيْحَانُ: الرِّزْقُ "

26

“Indeed, this is the true certainty”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 56:95).

39
Explanation from Mujāhid 39

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Indeed, this is the true certainty [al-Waqia 95] he said: "meaning the clear recompense."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ الْيَقِينِ [الواقعة: 95] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْجَزَاءَ الْمُبِينَ»
